rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinning zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Minor overreach in suggesting possible A/B TE nuance not clearly verifiable from the prompt alone.
Strong integration of maternal age, PCOS, endometrial thickness, oocyte maturity/yield, BMI, smoking status, prior cycle history, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately centered on age-related aneuploidy despite strong morphology. Minor imprecision around fresh vs frozen transfer considerations because cycle context is not fully specified.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, and consideration of PGT-A/cavity assessment. Slight overstatement of 3AA as 'top-grade' rather than simply high-quality, and some speculative comments on PCOS/fresh-cycle effects.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, transfer technique, luteal support, early monitoring, uterine cavity evaluation, and future PGT-A/FET discussion.
